official_definition: You can reveal two cards from your decktop. Among them, for each "Zeus"/"Z"/"GodKing", send an opposing Life to the Reserve. Add the revealed cards to the Hand.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Thunder God Bombardment] or [Thunder God Bombardment: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Thunder God Bombardment]", "give [Thunder God Bombardment]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
